answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 23427 Country: India Title: A few days ago, i went to a friend who is non muslim,where i ate chicken,later i came to know that chicken was not HALAL, Pls guide me what should i do now? Question: A few days ago, i went to a friend who is non muslim,where i ate chicken,later i came to know that chicken was not HALAL, Pls guide me what should i do now? Answer ID: 23427 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 987/987/M=1431) Now the only way is to do tauba and istighfar. Also give something in charity if you could and take care in future. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
